chunks: Do not fail to visit all of the sacred sites: Masjid Quba, Mashrabat Umm Ibrahim, Masjid al-Fadhikh, the graves of the martyrs, and Masjid al-Ahzab, which is Masjid al-Fath. And perform whatever voluntary salat (prayer) you wish in them.
When you come to the graves of the martyrs, say: “Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured; how excellent is the final abode.”

When you come to Masjid al-Fath, say: “O Helper of the distressed, O Answerer of the supplication of the afflicted, remove from me my grief, my anxiety, and my distress, just as You removed from Your Prophet—peace be upon him and his family—his anxiety, his grief, and his distress, and protected him from the terror of his enemy in this place.”

key_terms.الْمَشَاهِدَ: the sacred sites or places of visitation
key_terms.الْمُضْطَرِّينَ: those in dire need or distress
key_terms.مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءٍ: Masjid Quba, one of the notable mosques to be visited
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الْفَتْحِ: Masjid al-Fath, a site associated with supplication

ai.seo_question: What should be recited when visiting the graves of the martyrs and Masjid al-Fath in al-Madinah?
ai.summary: This passage encourages visiting notable sacred sites in al-Madinah, including the graves of the martyrs and Masjid al-Fath, and offering voluntary salat (prayer) there. It also teaches specific words of greeting and du'a to recite, linking visitation, remembrance, patience, and seeking divine relief through supplication.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
VISITING THE HOLY SHRINES AND GRAVES OF THE MARTYRS
And ensure that you visit all the significant places: the Quba Mosque, Mashrabat Umm Ibrahim, Masjid Al-Fadhikh, the graves of the martyrs, and Masjid Al-Ahzab, also known as Masjid Al-Fath. Perform voluntary prayers at these locations as you desire.
When you reach the graves of the martyrs, recite: 'Peace be upon you for your patience, and how excellent is the final abode.'
When you reach Masjid Al-Fath, say: 'O Responder to the cries of the distressed, O Answerer of the supplications of the afflicted, relieve me of my sorrow, distress, and grief as You relieved Your Prophet—peace and blessings be upon him and his family—of his sorrow, distress, and grief, and as You protected him from the terror of his enemies in this place.'"
